module adder_8bit(
    input [7:0] a, b, 
    input cin, 
    output [7:0] sum, 
    output cout);

    wire [8:0] carry; // Intermediate carry signals
    assign carry[0] = cin; // Initial carry

    // Full adder for each bit
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : full_adder
            assign sum[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ carry[i]; // Sum bit
            assign carry[i + 1] = (a[i] & b[i]) | (carry[i] & (a[i] ^ b[i])); // Carry out
        end
    endgenerate

    assign cout = carry[8]; // Final carry out

endmodule

module edge_detect(
	input clk,
	input rst_n,
	input a,
	
	output reg rise,
	output reg down
);

reg a_reg;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (!rst_n) begin
		a_reg <= 0;
		rise <= 0;
		down <= 0;
	end else begin
		rise <= 0; // Clear rise signal
		down <= 0; // Clear down signal

		if (a && !a_reg) begin
			rise <= 1; // Rising edge detected
		end else if (!a && a_reg) begin
			down <= 1; // Falling edge detected
		end

		a_reg <= a; // Update previous state
	end
end

endmodule

module freq_div (CLK_in,CLK_50,CLK_10,CLK_1,RST);
input CLK_in,RST;
output reg CLK_50,CLK_10,CLK_1;

reg [1:0] cnt_10; // 2-bit counter for 10MHz
reg [5:0] cnt_100; // 6-bit counter for 1MHz

always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        CLK_50 <= 0;
    end else begin
        CLK_50 <= ~CLK_50; // Toggle CLK_50 on every clock edge
    end
end

always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        cnt_10 <= 0;
        CLK_10 <= 0;
    end else begin
        if (cnt_10 == 3) begin
            CLK_10 <= ~CLK_10; // Toggle CLK_10 every 4 counts
            cnt_10 <= 0; // Reset counter
        end else begin
            cnt_10 <= cnt_10 + 1; // Increment counter
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        cnt_100 <= 0;
        CLK_1 <= 0;
    end else begin
        if (cnt_100 == 48) begin
            CLK_1 <= ~CLK_1; // Toggle CLK_1 every 49 counts
            cnt_100 <= 0; // Reset counter
        end else begin
            cnt_100 <= cnt_100 + 1; // Increment counter
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module fsm(IN,MATCH,CLK,RST);
input IN,CLK,RST;
output reg MATCH;

reg [2:0] state, next_state;

// State encoding
parameter IDLE = 3'b000,
          S1   = 3'b001, // 1
          S2   = 3'b010, // 10
          S3   = 3'b011, // 100
          S4   = 3'b100, // 1001
          S5   = 3'b101; // 10011

always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        state <= IDLE;
        MATCH <= 0;
    end else begin
        state <= next_state;
        if (next_state == S5) begin
            MATCH <= 1;
        end else begin
            MATCH <= 0;
        end
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        IDLE: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S1;
            else next_state = IDLE;
        end
        S1: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S1; // Stay in S1 on 1
            else next_state = S2; // Move to S2 on 0
        end
        S2: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S3; // Move to S3 on 1
            else next_state = IDLE; // Move back to IDLE on 0
        end
        S3: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S4; // Move to S4 on 1
            else next_state = S2; // Move back to S2 on 0
        end
        S4: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S5; // Move to S5 on 1
            else next_state = S2; // Move back to S2 on 0
        end
        S5: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S1; // Loop back to S1 on 1
            else next_state = IDLE; // Move back to IDLE on 0
        end
        default: next_state = IDLE; // Default case
    endcase
end

endmodule

`timescale 1ns / 1ps
module multi_booth_8bit (p, rdy, clk, reset, a, b);
   input clk, reset;
   input [7:0] a, b;
   output reg [15:0] p;
   output reg rdy;

   reg [15:0] multiplier;
   reg [15:0] multiplicand;
   reg [4:0] ctr;
   reg [1:0] state; // 00: Idle, 01: Process, 10: Done

   always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
      if (reset) begin
         multiplier <= {8'b0, a}; // Sign-extend a
         multiplicand <= {8'b0, b}; // Sign-extend b
         p <= 16'b0;
         ctr <= 5'b0;
         rdy <= 1'b0;
         state <= 2'b00; // Idle
      end else begin
         case (state)
            2'b00: begin
               if (ctr < 8) begin
                  state <= 2'b01; // Start processing
               end else if (ctr == 8) begin
                  rdy <= 1'b1; // Done
                  state <= 2'b10;
               end
            end
            2'b01: begin
               case ({multiplier[1:0]}) // Booth encoding
                  2'b00: begin
                     // Do nothing
                  end
                  2'b01: begin
                     p <= p + multiplicand; // Add multiplicand
                  end
                  2'b10: begin
                     p <= p - multiplicand; // Subtract multiplicand
                  end
                  2'b11: begin
                     // Do nothing
                  end
               endcase
               multiplier <= {1'b0, multiplier[15:1]}; // Shift right
               ctr <= ctr + 1;
               if (ctr == 7) begin
                  state <= 2'b10; // Move to done state
               end
            end
            2'b10: begin
               // Stay in done state
            end
         endcase
      end
   end
endmodule

module parallel2serial(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input [3:0] d,
    output reg valid_out,
    output reg dout
);

reg [1:0] cnt;
reg [3:0] data;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        cnt <= 2'b00;
        data <= 4'b0000;
        valid_out <= 1'b0;
        dout <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (cnt < 2'b11) begin
            dout <= data[3]; // Output MSB
            data <= {data[2:0], 1'b0}; // Shift left
            cnt <= cnt + 1;
            valid_out <= 1'b1; // Assert valid
        end else begin
            dout <= data[3]; // Output MSB
            data <= {data[2:0], 1'b0}; // Shift left
            cnt <= 2'b00; // Reset counter
            valid_out <= 1'b1; // Assert valid
        end
    end

module serial2parallel(
	input clk,
	input rst_n,
	input din_serial,
	input din_valid,
	output reg [7:0] dout_parallel,
	output reg dout_valid
);

	reg [7:0] shift_reg;
	reg [3:0] cnt;

	always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
		if (!rst_n) begin
			shift_reg <= 8'b0;
			cnt <= 4'b0;
			dout_valid <= 1'b0;
		end else begin
			if (din_valid) begin
				shift_reg <= {shift_reg[6:0], din_serial}; // Shift in the new bit
				if (cnt < 4'b0111) begin
					cnt <= cnt + 1; // Increment counter until 8 bits are received
				end
			end

			if (cnt == 4'b0111 && din_valid) begin
				dout_parallel <= shift_reg;
				dout_valid <= 1'b1; // Set output valid when 8 bits are collected
				cnt <= 4'b0; // Reset counter after output
			end else begin
				dout_valid <= 1'b0; // Clear dout_valid if not ready
			end
		end
	end

endmodule
